title: Render3D Tour
author: Seth Morrow
description: Ten small 3D scenes drawn into an ordinary image by render3dxt, the xTalk Suite's renderer: a sun and its planets, shapes, textures, materials, coloured lamps, a model read from text, hills built corner by corner, fog, clicking on things and 225 cubes on a wave. Click a planet to fly to it, and drag the picture to look round.
